item.desc: One of the biggest reasons I’d probably never move my family back to the UK is the incredible community atmosphere we enjoy here in China. I know places like this do exist in parts of the UK, but here they’re far more common and happen almost every evening. Our kids get to play, make friends, and burn off energy, while we get the chance to relax, chat, and feel part of the community. It’s something we’d genuinely find hard to live without.
